title: fix(console): design mode menu save refuses a 404 read, pins its publish, and keeps own entries out of contributed groups

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在设计模式里改应用菜单：删除时不再误删看不见的同名项，保存时不会覆盖别人刚发布的菜单，自己的菜单项也不能再放进其他软件包加的分组；键盘上空格键移动菜单项，回车键打开。
- 这是「设计模式里直接改菜单」专题的收尾，帮每一位在设计模式里改菜单的管理员解决问题。
- 出错时最坏的情况是保存被拒绝并说明原因，什么都不写入；改动只在前端，可以直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

Each item of the card and each review note added in its comments, with where it is fixed:

| Item | Fix |
|:---|:---|
| 1 (N7) id-less twins | `storedKeyer` (model): each level first matches id-less stored entries to served copies that carry the same own keys (the `id` the editor adds and the pruned `children` left out), in order, and only then falls back to type and target. A twin the reader was not shown (other `requiredPermissions`) no longer takes the shown twin's key. Twins that are equal in every key are matched by their place. An id-less entry is served with its stored keys, because `translateApp` only translates entries that have an id. |
| 2 (N8) 404 stored read | `MetadataClient.layered` answers a 404 as a view where every layer is `null`. `holdsStoredApp` notices this: the save refuses with a new sentence, `designMode.menu.storedUnread`, shown in the bar, and `readStoredMenu` answers `null` (unknown) instead of `[]`. On origin/main the `[]` marked every entry as another package's. |
| 3 (N9) contributed groups | A group another package contributes is no longer offered in 「Move to group」, has no 「Add menu item」 row, accepts no drop at its end or on its entries, and turns off 「Add an item before / after」 on its entries. |
| 4 (N6) version pin | The publish is pinned with the `/layers` read's `overlayVersion` (objectstack#36601's mechanism, the same one `publishedPinOf` uses for Studio's object buffer). A token is sent as `If-Match`; `null` is sent as `If-None-Match: *`. The pin is read at the address the publish writes to. For an installed app with a listed customization pair, the pair's layers are read before the base's body, so a publish landing between the two reads pairs an old pin with a new body and is refused, which is the safe direction. A pair the ensure door just created holds nothing yet (`If-None-Match: *`). A refused `409 METADATA_CONFLICT` discards the draft (as before) and is reported with `designMode.menu.publishedMoved`; saving again replays the edits over the newer menu. A server that serves no `overlayVersion` publishes unpinned, as before. **No server or spec change**: the publish door already reads `If-Match`. |
| N10 own end while the read is pending | `withOwnBeforeForeignRuns` (model): once the stored read lands, an own entry that sits in or after the run of another package's entries that closes its level is drawn just before that run, which is where the save puts it. |
| N12 Escape, then a late release | The click window now starts when the press that dragged is released, not when the drag ends. The window still lasts 300 ms. |
| N13 keys | `KeyboardSensor` `keyboardCodes`: start is Space only; end is Space or Enter; cancel is Escape. Enter on an entry that is not picked up is left to the link and opens its page. A new help line, `designMode.menu.keyboardHint`, says this, and it is also dnd-kit's screen-reader instruction. |
| N14 drop far away | The collision rule returns nothing for a pointer outside the menu's box, so the drop moves nothing. Keyboard moves (which have no pointer) still use `closestCenter`. |
| N15 drag-flag clears | Each clear path has its own case: a new press, a window `pointercancel`, and the existing case for `pointerup`. |
| N16 click during a keyboard move | A keyboard move sets its own flag, which a pointer press does not clear. Links stay closed until the move ends. |

`AppMenuSaveTexts` gains two optional sentences. A caller that passes neither (Studio's `addNewObjectToAppMenu`) gets the package sentence for a stored read with no app, and the server's own refusal for a moved publish. #36363 ruling (4) is untouched: stored labels are the app's own, and translations are not written here.

## Acceptance notes

- **Test placement deviation:** the dispatch asked for new test files named for the card. The component pins went into the existing shared harness instead, as a top-level `describe`, per AGENTS.md (ruling record 6583487846). The model and save pins are in new `-36538` files.
- **Locale packs:** the dispatch said en + zh. `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` requires every pack, so the three new keys are in all eleven packs. zh-Hant is regenerated by `gen:zh-hant`, never hand-written.
- **Residual, N10:** if the stored read on entry *fails* (rather than staying pending), the editor still cannot tell another package's entries apart, so an own entry added at a group's end is drawn after them. Nothing wrong is written: the save rebases it before them.
- **Residual, item 3:** while the stored read is still pending, a contributed group is not yet known, so a move into it during that window would still be saved at the end of the stored top level. Once the read lands, the group is no longer offered.
- **Residual, item 4:** if the ensure door answers a pair that the package list did not list and that this call did not create, that pair's layers were not read, so its publish is unpinned (as before).
- `MetadataClient.layered`'s 404-to-empty mapping is unchanged (client contract). The save recognises the all-null view by its shape: no stored app, so nothing is written.
- Studio's new-object-joins-menu path calls `readStoredMenu`. For a 404 it now gets `null`, and its existing refusal fires instead of writing an app document that holds only the new entry.
- One flake was seen once and did not reproduce: in a 272-file run, `designModeMenuSave-36363`'s `emitMetadataRefresh` mock showed 0 calls. Three reruns that included that file were green: the 4-file and 4-file single-worker probes, and the 165-file run.
- Not driven in a live browser; jsdom only.

## Verification

First read, by risk:
1. `designModeMenuSave.ts`, `prepareAppMenuSave`: the pair pin is read before the body, plus the `publishPin` choice after `ensureCustomization`.
2. `DesignModeMenu.tsx`: the drag-flag effect (`pointerDrag` / `keyboardDrag` / `pointerHeld`) and `endDrag`.
3. `designModeMenuModel.ts`: `storedKeyer`'s two-pass `adopt`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/designModeMenuSave-36538.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/designModeMenuModel-36538.test.ts`. Expect 2 files and 21 tests passing.
